artworks.title: Heracles and the Nemean Lion, metope from the Temple of Zeus at Olympia
artworks.artist: Unknown (workshop of the Temple of Zeus, Olympia)
artworks.description: Olympia's Temple of Zeus metope opens the Twelve Labours: the weary hero rests after the Nemean Lion while Athena looks on — Severe-style restraint instead of gore.

artworks.title: Heracles brings the Erymanthian boar to Eurystheus
artworks.description: The comic emblem of the Labours: Heracles delivers the live Erymanthian boar while Eurystheus hides in a pithos — Oltos' kylix made the cowering taskmaster the cycle's punchline.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing the Stymphalian Birds
artworks.description: Dürer restages the sixth Labour for Northern Renaissance eyes — Hercules loosing arrows at the man-eating birds of the Stymphalian marsh.

artworks.title: Heracles, Cerberus and Eurystheus (Caeretan hydria)
artworks.description: The last Labour on an archaic Caeretan hydria: Heracles hauls three-headed Cerberus before Eurystheus, who has flung himself into a pithos in panic.

artworks.title: Farnese Hercules
artworks.artist: After Lysippos (signed by Glykon of Athens)
artworks.year: c. 216 CE (Roman copy after a 4th-century BCE Greek original)
artworks.description: The Farnese Hercules — exhausted after the cycle, the golden apples of the Hesperides hidden behind his back — the Labours completed and immortality near.

popCulture.title: Labours of Hercules
popCulture.description: Lion, Hydra, Hind, Boar, Stables, Birds, Bull, Mares, Belt, Cattle, Apples, Cerberus — the twelve deeds that made Heracles immortal.

popCulture.title: Heracles
popCulture.description: The labours are the hero's public face — every vase, statue, and film returns to Eurystheus' impossible list.

films.title: Hercules
films.description: Disney's gospel-singing cartoon made the Labours a generation's first Heracles — merchandise and montage in place of Eurystheus' grim list.
